description: VideoGenDoctor Failure Taxonomy v0.1 — 60+ codes across 6 groups

codes.definition: The face identity of a character changes inconsistently between frames or segments.
codes.evidence: Compare face embeddings across keyframes; flag if cosine distance > threshold.

codes.definition: The body appearance (clothing, build) of a character changes inconsistently.
codes.evidence: Compare full-frame CLIP embeddings focused on character region.

codes.definition: A character appearing in the segment does not match any specified character.
codes.evidence: No face embedding match to known character anchors.

codes.definition: Character clothing changes between shots without narrative justification.
codes.evidence: High CLIP drift on character bounding box region across segments.

codes.definition: Multiple distinct faces detected when only one character is expected.
codes.evidence: InsightFace detects N>1 distinct identities in single-character shot.

codes.definition: Expected character face is not visible when a close-up or medium shot is specified.
codes.evidence: InsightFace detects no face in segment where shot_type requires face visibility.

codes.definition: Background scene changes unexpectedly between segments.
codes.evidence: CLIP background-region drift exceeds threshold across consecutive segments.

codes.definition: Scene environment does not match the specified location.
codes.evidence: CLIP similarity between frame and location description below threshold.

codes.definition: Lighting conditions change inconsistently within a shot.
codes.evidence: Per-frame luminance variance exceeds threshold within segment.

codes.definition: A scene object appears/disappears between frames without motion.
codes.evidence: Object detection bounding box absent in one frame and present in adjacent frame.

codes.definition: Background flickers or pulses unnaturally.
codes.evidence: High-frequency luminance variation in background region.

codes.definition: Time of day in the scene does not match specification.
codes.evidence: Sky/ambient light classification does not match expected time.

codes.definition: Unnatural frame-to-frame jitter not attributable to camera movement.
codes.evidence: High optical flow magnitude variance with low mean displacement.

codes.definition: Duplicate or dropped frames causing stutter.
codes.evidence: Adjacent frames with near-zero optical flow but non-zero expected motion.

codes.definition: Character or object motion is physically implausible.
codes.evidence: Optical flow direction/magnitude inconsistent with expected physics.

codes.definition: A required action or event does not occur in its expected segment.
codes.evidence: VLM judge Q&A for expected action returns negative.

codes.definition: Actions occur in incorrect temporal order relative to specification.
codes.evidence: Temporal order of detected action timestamps violates spec sequence.

codes.definition: Excessive motion blur degrades frame quality.
codes.evidence: Laplacian variance of keyframe below sharpness threshold.

codes.definition: Video appears frozen (no motion) when motion is expected.
codes.evidence: Optical flow magnitude near zero for entire segment.

codes.definition: Visual discontinuity at segment boundary.
codes.evidence: CLIP drift spike at segment boundary exceeds threshold.

codes.definition: Camera movement type deviates from the specified movement.
codes.evidence: Optical flow direction pattern does not match expected movement type.

codes.definition: Shot type (close-up, medium, wide) does not match specification.
codes.evidence: Face/body bounding box size ratio inconsistent with expected shot type.

codes.definition: Unplanned zoom-in or zoom-out occurs during the shot.
codes.evidence: Radial optical flow pattern detected without zoom specification.

codes.definition: Camera shake not consistent with specified movement.
codes.evidence: High-frequency oscillation in optical flow with low-frequency mean.

codes.definition: Camera angle (eye-level, high-angle, low-angle) deviates from specification.
codes.evidence: VLM judge identifies angle mismatch.

codes.definition: Unintended camera roll (rotation around optical axis).
codes.evidence: Rotational component in optical flow without roll specification.

codes.definition: A required prop from the specification is not visible in the segment.
codes.evidence: Object detection or VLM judge confirms prop absence.

codes.definition: A required prop is present but placed in the wrong screen region.
codes.evidence: Prop bounding box does not overlap expected region.

codes.definition: Generated content does not align with the text prompt.
codes.evidence: CLIP text-image similarity below threshold for prompt.

codes.definition: Number of visible characters does not match specification.
codes.evidence: InsightFace or VLM judge count differs from spec.

codes.definition: A prop present in the video is not in the specification.
codes.evidence: Object detection identifies unlisted object with high confidence.

codes.definition: Required prop is present but significantly occluded.
codes.evidence: Prop bounding box area below visibility threshold.

codes.definition: Color palette changes inconsistently across segments.
codes.evidence: HSV histogram distance between segments exceeds threshold.

codes.definition: Art style (photorealistic, animated, etc.) shifts between segments.
codes.evidence: CLIP style embedding drift across segments.

codes.definition: Visible compression artifacts (blocking, ringing) degrade quality.
codes.evidence: DCT block artifact score or BRISQUE exceeds threshold.

codes.definition: Texture patterns flicker or shimmer unnaturally.
codes.evidence: High temporal frequency in texture region optical flow.

codes.definition: Significant regions of frame are overexposed.
codes.evidence: Fraction of pixels with value > 250 exceeds threshold.

codes.definition: Significant regions of frame are underexposed or too dark.
codes.evidence: Fraction of pixels with value < 5 exceeds threshold.
